3 16-04-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 65 of 2023 registered for the offence under Section 376, 341, 323, 504, 506, 354C and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the prosecution case, the victim girl, who is a major is said to have been raped by the petitioner.
4. In the statement of the victim girl given under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C. it has come that the victim was in a relationship with the petitioner and the petitioner is in custody since 22.9.2023.
5. Considering the aforesaid facts, this application is allowed.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.8577 of 2024(3) dt.16-04-2024 6.

Let the petitioner, above named, be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Court of SDJM,
Samastipur in connection with Mahila P.S. (Samastipur) Case No. 65 of 2023.
